title: Rating agent suggests when a Story is published or a Reference accepted
description:
Owner decision 2026-11-22 (Ryan): suggestions only; a machine never writes a rating at any rung (PPY-e61642). This task keeps the other half of slice L3: change triggers. Besides its daily schedule, the rating agent wakes when a Story is published and when a Reference is accepted, and writes its suggestion (ratings_suggest, rung propose) beside the rating within the quiet window, adding the Story to the day's one review. A five stays a candidate for a person; a Story somebody rated is skipped.

**Acceptance criteria**
- A newly published Story gets a suggestion within the quiet window, at propose.
- A Story a person rated before the wake gets none.
- The day's review gains the Story instead of a second review being raised.
- Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs (below).

**Gherkin features needed**
- rating-suggestion-triggers.feature: a publish wakes the agent and the Story gets a suggestion; a rated Story is skipped; the day's review gains it.

**Infrastructure as code touched:** None (the change feeds already wake agents; rate.yaml gains wakes on stage_entered published and the Reference accepted change).

**Part of:** First agent: rating and curation on one site. Slice code L3 in docs/design/always-on-agents-architecture.md (section 12).
